strategy: Load actual mature website with existing QtWebEngine; retain local Qt application, navigation and calculations.
adoption: Actual QWebEngineView, temporary/off-the-record profile, real online public stage pages and their existing simulator. No new dependency.
distribution: Own adapter and extracted factual stage mapping; no upstream Svelte code or offline bundle distributed. Upstream source reuse/offline licensing remains a separate decision.
data_scope: Only public stage identity/config and normal/emergency mode enter the URL. Difficulty, relics, local run, account and chat state stay local; browser settings currently independent. Future personal-state support requires local-only handling, not personal query parameters.
video_review: Revisited original recording frame95s: Tomimi stage page, difficulty control, expandable route simulation/enemy count and bottom relic bar. Current website is loaded directly; remaining window proportions and local-state integration stay in project todo.
